title: Use Seedance 2.5 on Runway with up to 50 reference images per generation to…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 on Runway with up to 50 reference images per generation to improve character/world consistency  
Generate clips up to 30 seconds with full sound and dialogue, then use Runway’s edit/extend tools to continue the story  
Test model quality by prompting for natural facial performance, continuous shots, and character consistency across multiple scenes instead of relying on flashy effects  
Generate dialogue in Cantonese (or your target language) to evaluate how well Seedance maintains natural performance and language handling

Seedance が自然な演技と言語処理をどれだけうまく維持できるかを評価するために、広東語（または対象言語）でダイアログを生成しましょう
